summary.text: Margaret Burke is the Democratic candidate for Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 147 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Donna Scheuren.

A scientist and former pharmaceutical-industry professional who has advocated for families of people with disabilities, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is running on affordability, healthcare access and public education.

paragraphs.text: Margaret Burke graduated from North Babylon High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Cornell University's College of Agriculture and Life Sciences in 1990, a Ph.D. from Stony Brook University of the State University of New York in 1998, and a graduate degree from Cornell's Johnson School of Management in 2000.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as stay-at-home parent.

In a Ballotpedia survey, her campaign described her as a mom, former business professional and scientist who stepped away from a pharmaceutical-sector career in 2004 to care for her son with disabilities and has since advocated for families navigating special education and healthcare services.
The survey says she lives in Harleysville with her husband and their adult twins.
Burke's survey responses name affordability, healthcare access and a fairly funded public education system, especially for students with disabilities, as her three key messages.
